newsitem.title: USA: Mobil buys Argentine interest from BHP.
newsitem.headline: Mobil buys Argentine interest from BHP.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Thursday its Mobil Exploration and Development Argentina Inc (MEDA) unit had bought about a 28 percent interest in Argentina's Sierra Chata gas field and Chihuidos block from BHP Petroleum, a unit of Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd.
The company said in a statement the block was in the Neuquen Basin of Argentina.

The purchase price was not disclosed, but included a cash payment and an interest in certain Gulf of Mexico offshore blocks, including the Ewing Bank 990/946 and Green Canyon Blocks 58, 60, 152 and 153.

Sierra Chata's first discovery well was drilled in 1993. The gas field was developed and a gas plant installed before gas sales began in April 1995. Current gas sales total about 150 million cubic feet per day.

"With this acquisition, Mobil will be one of the first companies to sell gas to Chile through the Gas Andes pipeline to a market that's expected to grow rapidly," said Don Voelte, Mobil's chief operating officer for New Exploration and Producing Ventures.
